providerSettings.title: AI provider
providerSettings.subtitle: Where the Anthropic credential lives
providerSettings.proxyBody: Every AI call (roles, synthesis, chat) goes from the browser to the anthropic-proxy Supabase Edge Function, which checks the session, enforces quotas and only then calls Claude.
providerSettings.keyTitle: The API key is not entered here
providerSettings.keyBody: The only key is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, stored as a Supabase secret. It never goes in VITE_* variables or in the database, because anything there ends up visible in the browser.
